editorial.blurb: A casual spot where the Jjajangmyeon noodles and black bean noodles deliver genuine comfort, backed by huge, shareable portions at friendly prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Jjajangmyeon and enjoy it fresh in-person rather than to-go—the noodles stay better at temperature that way, and ask the kitchen to kick up the spice if you like heat.
